name: product-promo-3d
description: Product promo video with 3D animations built with Remotion

scripts.build: npx remotion render src/index.ts ProductPromo out/product-promo.mp4
scripts.render:gif: npx remotion render src/index.ts ProductPromo out/product-promo.gif --image-format png
scripts.render:still: npx remotion still src/index.ts ProductPromoThumbnail out/thumbnail.png
